claim_text: The proposed authorization model will evaluate a presented credential against authorization data, grant allowed access, deny non-authorized access, and record the decision event.
notes: NIST supports authorization credentials/lists, verification before grant, and audit logs; lookup representation, denial rule, and event schema are project choices.

claim_text: The simulator verification approach will trace requirements to tests and use repeatable unit and integration tests with controlled inputs, expected results, and evaluated outcomes.
notes: NASA guidance supports the testing discipline; project-specific acceptance criteria remain to be defined.

claim_text: The proposed controller permits at most one active floor output and denies every new request during activation as controller_busy without changing the existing timeout.
